text:
jen: FYI — noticed a regression hitting MQA configs for Qwen-7B on dedicated. p95 spikes after the kernel-picker tweak last night.

dmitri: ugh, what numbers are you seeing?

jen: baseline (before tweak) p50 ~12ms p95 ~48ms throughput ~120 req/s. after tweak: p50 ~14ms p95 ~320ms throughput ~95 req/s. error rate small but tail latency is awful.

kari: did the change flip to the generic attention kernel for some shapes?

jen: yes looks like for certain head_dim alignments the selector picks generic_kern_v2 instead of qkv_fused. seen on several racks.

lee: could be the head/kv dim packing mismatch for MQA. if num_key_value_heads doesn't divide kernel tile size we get scalar fallback and more page churn.

perf-bot: new flamegraph uploaded: https://perf.internal/runs/98765 (shows heavy memcpy + alloc hot paths) :mag:

jen: that flamegraph matches what I profiled locally — heavy nvmemcpy and then tiny bursts of device->host syncs when KV pages are moved in the paged layout.

dmitri: so hypothesis: kernel picker selects generic kernel -> increases transient allocation pattern -> paged KV fragmentation -> page faults under high concurrency -> p95 spike.

kari: makes sense. What model config did you run? num_key_value_heads? kv_dim? layout?

jen: run config: num_key_value_heads=16, kv_dim=384 per head, kv_layout=paged (default interleaved across heads). batch=12, seq=2048.

lee: try two quick experiments: 1) force qkv_fused via kernel_hint for that model (force_kernels=["qkv_fused"]) 2) change num_key_value_heads to 8 to align tiles. Also try kv_layout=head_contiguous instead of interleaved.

jen: good plan. I ran quick microbench: forcing qkv_fused drops p95 back to ~60ms but throughput still ~105 req/s. Changing num_key_value_heads->8 with head_contiguous layout gave p95 ~55ms and throughput ~118 req/s.

dmitri: so layout + heads adjustment is best so far. Any sign of correctness/regression on outputs?

jen: no functional diffs on our eval set. identical logits within fp16 eps.

kari: this sounds like a fragile selector heuristic. We should widen the selector table to prefer fused kernels for MQA head_dims that align to 64/128 boundaries, and add a fallback to try alternative layout rather than generic kernel.

lee: also want to instrument allocator: when paged layout is used we should emit a fragmentation metric (num_alloc_retries, pages_swapped, page_fault_duration) and wire those to console dashboard. current signals only show cache hit rate and token latency which hides the allocator thrash.

perf-bot: created ticket PERF-2134: "Selector -> generic_kern fallback causes paged-KV fragmentation on MQA Qwen" referencing run 98765.

dmitri: for short-term mitigation, can we add a model-profile override in catalog for qwen-7b-mqa: recommended num_key_value_heads=8, kv_layout=head_contiguous, kernel_hint=qkv_fused ?

jen: I'll add an opt-in override and roll to staging. patch looks like:
```json
{
  "model": "qwen-7b-mqa",
  "overrides": {
    "num_key_value_heads": 8,
    "kv_layout": "head_contiguous",
    "kernel_hint": ["qkv_fused"]
  }
}
```

kari: nice. For longer-term: update kernel picker scoring: add penalty when head_dim % tile != 0 and layout==paged. Also add a cheap simulation that predicts extra pages allocated for a request shape given current memory fragmentation estimate. If predicted extra pages > threshold, prefer alternative kernel/layout.

lee: agree. we should also add a perf test in CI that runs Qwen MQA with seq=2048 batch=12 and asserts p95 < 80ms on the reference HW image. Failing test should block the picker heuristic merge.

jen: will create a small perf harness under tools/bench and a nightly job. quick run command that reproduced the issue: 
```bash
./tools/bench/infer --model qwen-7b-mqa --batch 12 --seq 2048 --num-kv-heads 16 --kv-layout paged --workload=concurrent --duration 120
```

dmitri: thanks. do we need to revert the kernel-picker change in prod until this is fixed?

kari: we can hotpatch selector table for qwen-7b-mqa only. no full revert. also add alert when p95 delta > 3x baseline for any model in dedicated fleets.

jen: I'll push the catalog override + selector-table hotpatch to prod staging and keep monitoring. will post results in this thread. :white_check_mark:

perf-bot: status note: hotpatch applied to staging at 1745603000.

jen: staging numbers after hotpatch: p50 13ms p95 62ms throughput 116 req/s. looks stable so far.

lee: excellent. follow-up: file a small RFC for kernel-picker resilience logic and add the allocator metrics to Console. assigning to @dmitri and @kari for implementation.

dmitri: taking RFC + allocator metrics.

jen: thanks everyone — will close PERF-2134 after nightly validation completes.

perf-bot: nightly validation scheduled for 1745680000.
